historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly recognizes software evidence is only corroboration, though its all-interface sshpass command lacks target security.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Preserves manual visual criterion and strengthens fixture/recovery evidence.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row391 is link-flap behavior, not the three-state color legend.

original_test_intent: Visually verify the exact OOB port displays the specified green/yellow indications for disconnected, linked-idle and active-traffic states.
original_method: Map BMC/OOB interface to physical port and LED legend; retain alternate management; establish controlled no-link, linked-idle and active-traffic conditions; capture software state as corroboration and timestamped operator photo/video of each LED state; restore final connectivity.
manual_activity: Operator at the chassis identifies the exact OOB port, creates three controlled states, observes colors/blinking and records photo/video evidence.
required_inputs: Controlled link partner and activity generator
Operator and timestamped visual evidence storage
safety_requirements: Do not infer LEDs from ethtool
Do not disturb the sole management path without alternate access
Do not use broad interface changes
Stop and restore link on access loss or ambiguous port; no auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Correlate operator timestamps and fixture state
Do not claim visual observation or verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ip/ethtool output can corroborate link and activity but cannot establish physical colors or blinking; sshpass and all-interface enumeration are not authoritative.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use target-bound read-only ip/ethtool/counter capture only as synchronized corroboration for operator photos/video.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All three green/yellow LED states and 10-minute allocations are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Synchronize a declared link fixture and traffic stimulus with software counters and operator video/photos for each LED state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact mapping, three-state fixture, alternate access, evidence timing and restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Software cannot replace the physical color/blink criterion.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Cable/link manipulation may interrupt management; camera color/exposure can misrepresent LED state.

project_override_considerations: Owner must confirm whether yellow is always off, acceptable blink cadence and required witness/photo/video quality for the exact hardware revision.
expected_evidence: OOB interface/BMC/physical-port map and LED legend
Timestamped photos/video for all three states
Final OOB/BMC reachability and preserved logs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek preserves the manual LED boundary and treats software as partial evidence; the review only tightens targeting and evidence.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution blocks without physical access, exact port/legend, controlled states, alternate access or reliable visual evidence.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row390 Wistron-Networking-00379-V003: approve the exact OOB interface/BMC/physical-port map, hardware-revision LED legend including yellow-off and blink expectations, controlled no-link/idle/activity fixture, alternate management path and acceptable photo/video/witness evidence.

review_improvement: Defines three reproducible physical states and evidence correlation without pretending software telemetry observes LED color.
independent_technical_reasoning: Carrier and packet counters expose electrical/logical state, but they cannot prove which chassis LED is lit, its color or blink pattern. The criterion therefore remains manual and must be tied to the mapped port and controlled traffic state.
